description: Signal connections in a scene file. Each connection answers with its flags as the number and as flagNames; persist is on every connection, since a scene saves no other kind. A connect of a pair already connected says alreadyConnected, with flagsBefore when it changed the flags. A connect to a method the target does not have is still written, as the editor's own dialog allows, since the method may be written next; methodFound false says so, and until the method exists the signal fails each time it is emitted. list marks editable false on a connection an instanced scene makes inside itself, which only that scene can change. Through the editor when one serves the project; with none, a headless engine runs the editor's own tool and the answer says so under writtenBy, or readBy for a read. That engine runs every script of the file, where the editor runs only tool scripts, so what a script changes as the file loads or as a property is set is put back before anything is saved, and a file where that cannot be done, such as a scene whose script does not compile, is refused and nothing is written. An editor of the project that is running and has not reached this server is waited for rather than written around. Operations: connect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName): connect a signal to a method; disconnect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName): remove a connection; list: every connection in the scene.

flags.description: connect: Object.ConnectFlags, such as 1 for deferred. Only for op connect.

methodName.description: The method on that node, called when it emits. Only for ops connect, disconnect.

nodePath.description: list: only connections involving this node. Only for op list.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

signalName.description: The signal it emits, such as "pressed". Only for ops connect, disconnect.

sourceNodePath.description: The node that emits. Only for ops connect, disconnect.

targetNodePath.description: The node whose method is called. Only for ops connect, disconnect.
